target.detail: the freestanding ATM in the shop wall

setup: Convenience store ATM set in the wall, telehandler nicked from the site down the road, chain and a three a.m. with nobody about. Loud, quick, over.
on_success: Forks under the machine, wall gives before the alarm finishes its first ring, ATM in the back of the van and away over the fields.
on_fail: The machine's bolted deeper than it looks and the telehandler stalls half-in. Now you've got a stuck digger and blue lights closing.
on_crit: Full cassette, only just refilled for the weekend. It's heavier than you dared hope.

target.name: the phone shop
target.detail: roller shutter, stock room at the back

setup: Phone shop, roller shutter you can pop with a van bumper, a stock room behind the counter full of boxed handsets still sealed.
on_success: Reverse through the shutter, two of you clear the stockroom in ninety seconds, gone before the response car's even dispatched.
on_fail: Bollards. New ones. The kind that stop a van dead and fold your bumper into your radiator.
on_crit: New stock delivery was that afternoon. The back room's stacked to the ceiling.

target.detail: the precinct unit with the roller shutter that's never worked right

setup: Shutter half-jammed since Christmas and everyone knows it, bollards out front but the one on the left's been clipped so many times it moves, and a window they load for the Saturday and forget to empty.
on_success: Bollard goes over, shutter goes up in one, ninety seconds inside, and you're back on the ring road before the alarm finishes its first cycle.
on_fail: The bollard doesn't move. Turns out they replaced it Tuesday. The van's front end is now evidence and you're on foot.
on_crit: The whole tray was in the window. They'd loaded it for the weekend and nobody put it back in the safe.

target.detail: the freestanding ATM set into the shop wall

setup: Convenience-store cashpoint set in the wall, a telehandler nicked off the site down the road, a chain, and a three a.m. with nobody about. Loud, quick, and over before the road wakes up.
on_success: Forks under the machine, the wall gives before the alarm finishes ringing, ATM in the back of the van and away across the fields on a route no camera watches.
on_fail: It's bolted deeper than it looks and the telehandler stalls with the machine half out. Now you've a stuck digger and blue lights closing.
on_crit: Full cassette, only just refilled for the weekend rush. It's heavier than you dared hope and you nearly can't lift it.

target.name: Sim
target.detail: the phone shop stockroom, just delivered to

setup: Phone shop with a roller shutter a van bumper pops, a stockroom behind the counter full of sealed handsets, and a delivery that landed this afternoon and won't be counted till Monday.
on_success: Reverse through the shutter, two of you clear the stockroom in ninety seconds flat, gone before the response car's even been dispatched.
on_fail: Bollards. New ones. The kind that stop a van dead and fold the bumper up into the radiator with a noise like the end of the plan.

target.detail: the retail-park offie stacked for the bank holiday

setup: Big retail-park off-licence, stacked to the rafters for the bank holiday, a shutter and a single overnight alarm, and a car park you can build up real speed across at four in the morning.
on_success: Straight through the shutter, trolley the spirits into the van by the pallet, and it's on the estate at cost-plus-nothing by breakfast.
on_fail: There's a guard doing rounds you didn't cost in, and he's already on the radio describing your van's back doors.

target.detail: the village post office with the safe and the pension day tomorrow

setup: A village post office, a safe loaded ready for pension day, a front you can put a Transit through, and a nearest patrol car twenty minutes away on a good night, which most nights out here are.
on_success: Through the front, chain on the safe, safe on the flatbed, and four miles of unlit lane between you and anyone who could stop it.
on_fail: The postmistress lives above the shop and she's dialling before you've got the chain on, and twenty minutes turns out to be less than you thought.
on_crit: Pension day's float came early. The safe's fuller tonight than it'll be for a month.

target.detail: the vape shop that's really a cash business

setup: A vape shop that shifts far more than it declares, a till that never empties properly, a flimsy shutter, and an owner who can't report the true loss without explaining the true takings.
on_success: Through the shutter, till and stock into the van, and the owner reports a fraction of what actually went because the rest was never officially there.
on_fail: The 'flimsy' shutter's been reinforced since the last time somebody tried, and the van bounces off it into the bus stop.

target.name: Terry
target.detail: the bookies that took a fortune on the big race

setup: A high-street bookies the day after the big race, a safe that didn't get banked because the security van route got changed, a back door onto a service road, and a night watchman who clocks off at two.
on_success: In off the service road at ten past two, safe out on a sack truck, away down the back lanes with a day's losing bets turned into your winning one.
on_fail: The watchman worked a double and he's still there at ten past two, and he's braver than the wage should make him.

target.detail: the unit you thought was a stockroom

setup: A shutter, a quiet corner, a tip-off that it's a phone importer's overflow store. You put the van through it clean and fast, exactly to plan, and then the headlights show you what's actually inside.
on_success: Wrong unit — but it's a wholesaler's, and pallets are pallets. You take what fits and leave, richer by accident and quieter about it.
on_fail: It's a charity furniture store. The van's wrecked, the take is a sofa and a box of donated mugs, and you've done all this for nothing that sells.
